content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or restricted, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-every-detail-you-4|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-solutions-west-africa-one-afternoon-4|digital]] creators face a significant barrier to launching their online stores. This guide focuses on deploying your digital store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-16|Cloudflare R2]] Pages, providing a robust solution that bypasses these limitations. You will leverage the power of NOWPayments for seamless crypto transactions, ensuring that your store is fully operational without dependency on conventional payment processors. By choosing this infrastructure, you regain control over your commerce without the risk of platform lockout.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure is built specifically for creators operating in environments where traditional payment platforms have failed. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages, you significantly enhance your site's resilience against outages and restrictions. The proprietary technology stack allows you to own every element of your store, from hosting to payment processing, ensuring that you face no interruptions. Unlike conventional platforms that impose fees and account restrictions, this architecture provides you with the sovereignty needed to thrive in any economic landscape.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start the deployment, you need to gather essential tools and resources. First, create accounts on Cloudflare and NOWPayments. Next, familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as it will serve as your backend logic layer. You should also prepare your product files, whether they are ebooks, courses, or digital assets. Lastly, review the Sovereign Blueprint, which outlines the entire deployment process for Stack 01. With these elements in place, you are ready to establish a powerful digital commerce presence.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To implement your payment and delivery system, begin by configuring your NOWPayments account. This will allow you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Next, set up Google Apps Script to automate order processing and product delivery. Here, you'll integrate the webhook provided by NOWPayments to ensure that transactions trigger the delivery of digital products instantly. This automation guarantees a seamless experience for your customers, ensuring that they receive their purchases without unnecessary delays.
Full ownership of your digital store means no reliance on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it's time to go live. Publish your site on Cloudflare Pages, making sure all links and functionalities are operational. After publishing, conduct a test transaction with NOWPayments to ensure everything works as intended. Monitor the transaction process from order placement to product delivery. Successful processing of your first transaction verifies that your store is fully functional and ready for customers. This initial success is crucial for building confidence in your infrastructure.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your digital store live, consider strategies for scaling your operations. You can start by adding more products to your store, leveraging the features of Cloudflare to optimize performance. Explore marketing tactics to drive traffic to your site, and consider utilizing the Edge Commerce Stack for additional capabilities. This stack can handle more products and provide enhanced configurations like SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for better email deliverability. Continuous improvements and expansions will ensure your store remains competitive.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Cloudflare Pages provides unmatched performance and scalability for your online business.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create accounts on Cloudflare and NOWPayments. Prepare your product files and familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script. Deploy your site on Cloudflare Pages. Configure NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Set up Google Apps Script to automate order processing. Conduct a test transaction to ensure everything is operational. Promote your store to attract customers. Regularly update your product offerings to keep your store fresh.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Start by using Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions. This combination provides a robust infrastructure at no cost, allowing you to accept payments seamlessly and manage your digital products effectively.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for deployment, taking about 4-6 hours. Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack, uses Cloudflare Pages and Workers, deployed in 48 hours, and includes more advanced features for scalability and security.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both platforms allow you to host your digital product store. GitHub Pages is ideal for smaller setups, while Cloudflare Pages offers enhanced performance and scalability, making it suitable for larger operations.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a minimal fee of 0.5% per transaction, with no hidden costs. This transparent pricing structure allows you to maximize your profits while providing a seamless payment experience for your customers.
What kind of products can I sell using this infrastructure?

You can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, courses, digital templates, software, and more. The flexibility of the infrastructure allows you to customize your offerings based on your target audience.
NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a simple setup.
